$comment: Mission 1 (docs/design.md, Campaign spine). Within 60 s of control at the Ferry Building, a bad Footman with subtlety-1 tells snatches another Footman's groceries, with a hydrant within 15 m; the first melt lands at about 90 s. Outro: sign up for the FiDi coworking desk (the form asks 'What are you building?' and records a StartupDefined kit id), then cone the robotaxi parked in your spot. Places are street locations, not addresses.
title: Hot Desk
summary: Your first morning in the city. A robot is stealing groceries outside the Ferry Building, your cofounder is texting, and there is a desk with your name on it in the Financial District. Probably.

cofounder.name: Your cofounder
cofounder.description: Built Bot Check beta in a weekend. Texts in lower case.

host.name: Desk host
host.role: Host at the FiDi coworking desk
host.description: Has a lanyard, a clipboard and a waitlist for the nap pod.

thief.note: Subtlety-1 tells: tails a good Footman, asks you to rate the sidewalk, carries a weightless bag.

shopper.note: The good Footman whose groceries go missing.

squatter.note: Parked in your spot. Good robotaxis stop dead for a cone.

steps.note: Control starts on the Ferry Building plaza.

place.label: The Ferry Building plaza
place.source: Hand-placed on the plaza in front of the clock tower

lines.speaker: cofounder
lines.text: welcome to sf!! the blaster is in your bag. it's water. it rusts the bad ones. only the bad ones, ideally

lines.speaker: cofounder
lines.text: warning diamonds mark hostile robots. watch their wind-up, and leave helpful robots alone

steps.note: Staged within 60 s of control, near a hydrant.

place.label: Embarcadero Plaza, by Market St and Steuart St
place.source: Hand-placed on the plaza beside the Market St and Steuart St corner

lines.speaker: cofounder
lines.text: see the footman following the other one? 2 metres behind, every turn. and its bag is empty. that's not normal

steps.hint: Hold aim without spraying to Watch it: its path, its sound, its status light.

lines.speaker: cofounder
lines.text: hold your aim on it without spraying. that's Watch. look at its trail

steps.hint: Spray it. The rust bar fills; at full it seizes, slumps and melts. A hydrant is right there if you run dry.

lines.speaker: cofounder
lines.text: it took the groceries!! spray it. hydrant's right there if you run out

lines.speaker: cofounder
lines.text: first melt!!! it'll be restored from backup. some memories may be lost. not ours

lines.speaker: cofounder
lines.text: ok your desk is on Montgomery St. they give it away if you're late. go go go

target.label: The FiDi coworking desk, Montgomery St

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: Hi! We're holding your desk for five minutes. After that it goes to the next founder on the waitlist.

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: Welcome! One question before I hand you a lanyard: what are you building?

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: Love it. Love it. You're desk 14. Your stuff goes in a locker; there's no garage, sorry.

place.label: The curb outside the desk, Montgomery St
place.source: Hand-placed on the curb outside the desk

lines.speaker: cofounder
lines.text: also a robotaxi is parked in your spot. cone it. robotaxis stop dead for a cone on the hood. it's harmless

steps.hint: Throw a cone onto its hood. You carry three; the car restocks them.

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: And you've coned a robotaxi on day one. You're going to fit right in.

lines.speaker: cofounder
lines.text: we have a desk!!! and a startup!!! and 18 months of runway. that's basically forever

lines.speaker: cofounder
lines.text: it got away with the groceries. it's fine. it's not fine. try again?

steps.hint: Watch it first, then keep the stream on it. The hydrant beside the plaza swaps your water.

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: So sorry, the desk went to a founder building an app for ordering desks. Next opening is in a minute!
